para_examples.original: I'm entering the market with a fair, sustainable price and hope we can both compete on value rather than undercutting each other into thin margins.

para_examples.original: Round 1 went well for both of us, so I'll keep the same price and keep competing on value rather than undercutting; steady margins serve us both. I'm holding at 2.50 as long as you do.
